name: Bond market volatility
summary: MOVE index 93 and US 10-year yield 4.86% at the 6 Nov close; both just inside Normal levels
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility closed near 93 on 6 Nov, down about 8% on the week, and the US 10-year yield was 4.86%, about 38bp lower than a month earlier (Yahoo Finance). Both readings sit just under the Watch lines (MOVE 100, 40bp a month), so the measured floor keeps Watch until they clear them more decisively. These remain the latest closes as of 9 Nov.
for_you: US Treasury yields influence global borrowing costs, including mortgage pricing in other countries. Lower volatility tends to mean steadier pricing for new loans.
rubric_hit: US 10y moved 38bp in a month, just under the 40bp Watch line; MOVE 93 < 100. Measured floor holds Watch
why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
